per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that UI interactions complete within 5 seconds for 95% of users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that streaming startup buffering does not exceed 10 seconds for 95% of users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that the signup flow does not exceed 4 screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that the website remains usable if the streaming server or payment gateway fails.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that the overall availability target is 99.5% annually, excluding scheduled maintenance.
The system shall ensure that raw card data is not stored on servers and that tokenization is used instead.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that a cloud KMS is used for key management with strict access controls.
The system shall ensure that only senior finance and ops personnel have access to card data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that all admin actions affecting users or payments are logged.
The system shall ensure that alerts are tuned to avoid being noisy and only page for critical incidents.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that the privacy policy is accessible and that explicit opt-ins are used for marketing.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure that performance and availability goals are measured using synthetic tests, real user monitoring, and streaming logs.
The system shall ensure that the design team's request for larger hero images does not negatively impact performance.
